verdict.rationale: Evidence shows automatic categorization/reconciliation and an AI assistant (Command) that can be asked to do tasks, but there is no mention of user-defined recurring/scheduled jobs or workflows; the API/MCP layer that might enable this is explicitly described as 'soon' (not yet shipped), and probes for API endpoints 404. Missing for 10: any documented scheduling/recurring-workflow feature, evidence of a live automation API or MCP layer, and independent confirmation of scheduled task execution.
